question_text: What can cause skidding on bends?

options.text: Faulty shock-absorbers
Insufficient or uneven tyre pressure
Load is too small

correct_answers.text: Faulty shock-absorbers
Insufficient or uneven tyre pressure

comment: Defective shock absorbers can be the cause of a vehicle skidding or swinging off the curve when turning. The correct tire pressure specified by the manufacturer is important for a stable vehicle position in curves. It is tailored to the overall design of the vehicle. Too low or too different tire pressure reduces driving stability and increases the risk of skidding on turns. Too high a load has an influence on the driving stability. There is not too little loading.

question_text: What can cause skidding on bends?

options.text: Heavy braking
Driving fast on a wet roadway
Slight acceleration when leaving the bend

correct_answers.text: Heavy braking
Driving fast on a wet roadway

comment: In curves, the following factors can lead to skidding: 1. excessive speed; 2. wet or icy roads; 3. strong braking. In turns, much of the stiction forces are needed for the cornering forces that hold the vehicle in the lane. If you brake too much, the stiction is instead used largely for the transmission of the braking force. As a result, the cornering forces are too low to counteract the centrifugal force, the same applies to excessive speed. On wet roads, a film of water between the road surface and the tire reduces grip and promotes skidding.

question_text: What can cause a dangerous situation?

options.text: Cutting corners
Dipping your headlights too late
Driving too far behind the vehicle in front

correct_answers.text: Cutting corners
Dipping your headlights too late

comment: When cutting a corner, the vehicle in the curve is directed inward and the opposite lane is used as well in order to progress faster. This represents a serious threat to oncoming traffic and can lead to serious accidents. Dimming too late can also jeopardize oncoming drivers as they are dazzled and drive almost blindly.

question_text: What do you do if the white car does not stop?

options.text: Reduce speed, waive your priority
Sound your horn and try to pass in front of the car

correct_answers.text: Reduce speed, waive your priority

comment: Even if you are in the right of way: Do not take risks in case of bad traffic behavior of other participants. Draw attention to the error with horn signal, but do not insist on your right and renounce your right of way. Lower your speed as well.

question_text: What results in specific risks to motorcyclists?

options.text: Riding with the visor open
Riding in heavy rain
Changes in the road surfacing

correct_answers.text: Riding with the visor open
Riding in heavy rain
Changes in the road surfacing

comment: If you ride with the visor open, an insect can fly into it at any time. This can be very painful and distracting. If the road surface changes, there is a risk of falling down because the grip level is different. In heavy rain, motorbikes are more likely to aquaplane than cars.

options.text: I reduce my speed so that the overtaking vehicle can pull in ahead of me
I accelerate so that the overtaking vehicle can pull in behind me
I maintain my speed because there is sufficient safety distance

correct_answers.text: I reduce my speed so that the overtaking vehicle can pull in ahead of me

comment: The overtaking vehicle will probably not be able to complete its overtaking manoeuvre as planned. To prevent an accident, you should let the overtaking vehicle get into the lane.

question_text: Why should you allow the truck to change lane?

options.text: Because the driver of the truck may fail to see me
Because I should show due consideration to the truck
Because the alternate merging procedure applies here

correct_answers.text: Because the driver of the truck may fail to see me
Because I should show due consideration to the truck

comment: If you are in the dead corner of the truck and the truck suddenly exhaust yourself, a dangerous situation can occur and you would have to slow down. Since there is enough space between the vehicle in front, you should take the truck into account and enable it to change lanes.

question_text: As a motorcyclist , why is it important that you adopt an anticipatory driving style especially on very winding stretches of road?

options.text: Because the turning radius can reduce as the road continues
Because otherwise I will not be able to see dirt on the roadway in time
Because it means I am able to adjust myself in good time to the actions of oncoming traffic

correct_answers.text: Because the turning radius can reduce as the road continues
Because otherwise I will not be able to see dirt on the roadway in time
Because it means I am able to adjust myself in good time to the actions of oncoming traffic

comment: By riding with foresight, you can recognise the behaviour of oncoming traffic and potentially dangerous situations, such as dirt on the road or a change in cornering radius, in good time and adapt your riding behaviour accordingly.

question_text: As a motorcyclist, you can easily go unnoticed by other vehicle drivers. How can you reduce this risk?

options.text: I avoid remaining for too long in the blind spot to the side of other vehicles
I try to see the road situation from the perspective of other vehicle drivers
Before taking a turn, I try to establish eye-contact with other drivers in my vicinity

correct_answers.text: I avoid remaining for too long in the blind spot to the side of other vehicles
I try to see the road situation from the perspective of other vehicle drivers
Before taking a turn, I try to establish eye-contact with other drivers in my vicinity

comment:
Try to put yourself in the shoes of the drivers involved so that you can better understand what they might do next. This way, you may be able to recognise a potential hazard and react to it in good time.
If you are driving in a vehicle's side blind spot, the driver will not be able to see you. If possible, drive in such a way that you are not in the blind spot for an unnecessarily long time. You should also try to make eye contact with the drivers involved before turning to ensure that they can see you.

question_text: What can cause a dangerous situation?

options.text: Brakes which engage heavily on one side
Too much steering-wheel play
Disturbed reception of traffic information on the radio

correct_answers.text: Brakes which engage heavily on one side
Too much steering-wheel play

comment: If a foot brake has a strong one-sided effect, the vehicle may swing off laterally during braking. The car may skid and overturn. Therefore, unequal braking forces are extremely dangerous. Excessive steering can also lead to skidding at high speeds because you can no longer keep the lane properly. A disturbed traffic radio is not a technically dangerous defect.

question_text: What are the effects of listening to loud music - especially with an extremely loud bass volume - in the car?

options.text: Blind people lose their orientation when they are near the car
The driver’s attention is significantly impaired
It makes it easier for blind people to recognise where the road is

correct_answers.text: Blind people lose their orientation when they are near the car
The driver’s attention is significantly impaired

comment: Loud music in the car leads to two negative effects: The driver is distracted by the music and he cannot concentrate on the road. Deep basses in particular lead to strong uncertainty in blind road users. These can lose their orientation, especially with low-frequency music.

question_text: What can create a hazard when driving?

options.text: A service brake that responds heavily on one side
An excessive amount of play in the steering
A faulty dipped headlight

correct_answers.text: A service brake that responds heavily on one side
An excessive amount of play in the steering
A faulty dipped headlight

comment: If the dipped headlights are not working, you will see poorly on the one hand and you will be seen worse on the other. If the service brake is too one-sided, the vehicle could swerve or have a longer braking distance. If there is too much play in the steering, the steering command will not be carried out.
